clues.it: Fabio era seduto su una sedia, in una stanza diversa da Giada e da solo sul Ponte.
clues.en: Fabio was sitting on a chair, in a different room from Giada and alone on the Deck.

clues.it: Tea era accanto a una cassa e a nord di Nino, ma non era accanto a una corda.
clues.en: Tea was beside a crate and north of Nino, but was not beside a rope coil.

clues.it: Ugo era accanto a una cassa e a nord di Nino.
clues.en: Ugo was beside a crate and north of Nino.

clues.it: Vito era nella 6ª colonna, nella 4ª riga e accanto a un barile o a una corda.
clues.en: Vito was in the 6th column, in the 4th row and beside a barrel or a rope coil.

clues.it: Marta era nella 9ª colonna, a nord di Rosa e in Plancia.
clues.en: Marta was in the 9th column, north of Rosa and on the Bridge.

clues.it: Luca era accanto a una pianta e a ovest di Vito.
clues.en: Luca was beside a plant and west of Vito.

clues.it: Giada era accanto a uno scaffale, a una rete e in Plancia.
clues.en: Giada was beside a shelf, a net and on the Bridge.

clues.it: Nino era in una stanza diversa da Marta, ma non era accanto a una pianta.
clues.en: Nino was in a different room from Marta, but was not beside a plant.

clues.it: Dario era nella 9ª riga e nella stessa stanza di Olga, ma non era accanto a una sedia.
clues.en: Dario was in the 9th row and in the same room as Olga, but was not beside a chair.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da solo con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Olga era nella 11ª riga, accanto a una cassa e sul Molo.
clues.en: Olga was in the 11th row, beside a crate and on the Dock.

clues.it: Rosa era a ovest di Fabio.

general_clues.en: 6 in the west half of the grid.
6 in the north half of the grid.

steps.it: L'indizio di Fabio lascia una sola casella libera: riga 1ª, colonna 4ª.
steps.en: Fabio's own clue leaves a single free square: row 1st, column 4th.

steps.it: Solo Tea può stare nella 2ª riga: per tutti gli altri è esclusa, quindi la casella in colonna 12ª è sua.
steps.en: Tea is the only one who can be in the 2nd row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 12th is theirs.

steps.it: Solo Ugo può stare nella 3ª riga: per tutti gli altri è esclusa, quindi la casella in colonna 11ª è sua.
steps.en: Ugo is the only one who can be in the 3rd row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 11th is theirs.

steps.en: Vito's own clue leaves a single free square: row 4th, column 6th.

steps.en: Giada's own clue leaves a single free square: row 7th, column 10th.

steps.it: L'indizio di Olga lascia una sola casella libera: riga 11ª, colonna 5ª.

steps.it: L'indizio di Rosa più le righe e le colonne già occupate lasciano una sola casella: riga 12ª, colonna 3ª.
steps.en: Rosa's clue plus the rows and columns already taken leave a single square: row 12th, column 3rd.
